nodes.message: Pre-Bootstrap development-platform gate requires explicit accepted owner review before deferred DR-70 product work may resume.

nodes.objective: Resume #754 from the project-owner key-2885 DR-70 review recorded in comment 5752994015. Preserve the proven real channel geomorphology and the accepted canopy, cave/interior, exterior-fluid, determinism, and exact-volume improvements. Repair only the remaining review failures: resolve the unacceptable ocean-biome/presentation context for intended island hydrology using already-accepted world semantics; improve the visible water realization and surrounding bank/substrate/material dressing so the authored channel reads coherently in-world; and qualify a deterministic representative review specimen large and legible enough to demonstrate the integrated system. The key-2885 specimen is evidence, not a sacred lock: select another deterministic specimen only when current accepted semantics naturally exercise the system better. Produce a new qualified artifact and concrete material delta for human review. Automated validation belongs in GitHub Actions.
nodes.stop_boundary: Do not fabricate hydrology for the review, invent new watershed/biome/aesthetic policy, or broadly retune terrain morphology, caves, ecology density, pacing, final visual identity, or structure architecture. Preserve the positive real-channel result and previously accepted canopy/cave/exterior-fluid fixes. If accepted Authorship/Content/Presentation semantics cannot resolve the biome/presentation context or provide a representative specimen, stop at that precise dependency. Do not touch #488/#489, run project validation on the DigitalOcean host, or machine-pass the product gate.

nodes.message: Post-platform DR-70 repair evidence is machine-complete. On Nicholas' local workstation, inspect the newly qualified artifact and verify that the hydrology is presented in an appropriate island context rather than the failed ocean-biome presentation; the water, channel banks/substrate, and surrounding material dressing read coherently; the specimen is representative enough to demonstrate the integrated system; the previously proven real channel geomorphology remains legible; and the accepted canopy, cave/interior, exterior-fluid, determinism, and exact-volume improvements have not regressed. Machines must not self-pass this re-review.
Stop for explicit owner program/phase reconciliation before promoting Bootstrap Province to PRIMARY_ACTIVE.
